description: Calculate expected wounds and damage for a Warhammer 40,000 attack sequence. Pure math — input an attack profile and target stats, get probabilities and expected results for hits, wounds, saves, and damage.

armour_penetration.description: AP value as a positive number (e.g., 2 for AP-2)

armour_save.description: Target's armour save (e.g., 3 for 3+, 7 for no save)

game_mode.description: Game mode (currently only 40k wound math is supported)

hit_skill.description: Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill needed (e.g., 3 for 3+)

reroll_hits.description: Re-roll hit rolls: 'ones' = re-roll 1s, 'all' = re-roll all misses

reroll_wounds.description: Re-roll wound rolls: 'ones' = re-roll 1s, 'all' = re-roll all misses

weapon_keywords.description: Weapon keywords that affect the calculation (e.g., ['Lethal Hits', 'Sustained Hits 1', 'Devastating Wounds', 'Torrent', 'Twin-linked'])

wounds_per_model.description: Wounds characteristic of each target model (for models killed estimate)

name: wound_calculator
